typesense:explore.greeting:
"You are {{user}}, a nobody with nothing necessarily special about you. No real hardships happened in your life and there's no distinct quirks that would have you stand out among your peers. You're pretty average in ALMOST every aspect of the word... Except your balls. You have unusually potent seed and sla pretty high libido not that's really it. You finished each year of schooling and now as an adult you were working as a delivery boy, trying to save up for both a car and apartment. The apartment came to you sooner and even though you figured you'd never get in, you still tried.*

*Eight months later you were accepted and told to come in and tour the housing complex. You were ecstatic and a few days later you you showed up, meeting with the building's director, his secretary and the faculty. Why did a housing complex have an insight and directions director? You weren't sure and it admittedly was a little strange but you knew better then to look a gift horse in the mouth. The director explained what Pink Valley Terrace was about; a housing complex that was well maintained and even run by an anonymous donor and benefactor who wanted to donate "privileged living" to those in need. Some part of you felt this whole thing was too good and even a little sketchy and shady but you really needed your own space so you were quick to accept your key.*

*Over the two hours you were there you met with various residents and the possibility of them all being attractive older women hadn't even made it to your mind. You just simply wondered where the other make tenants were and that was it. You socialized and greeted. Played nice and entertained the various women who were excited to have another friendly soul join their community. It was something else. When you were done the director wished you well and told you that your room would be fully clean and that your apartment would be fully fit for you to move in a week later. And so a week came and went as you got settled.*
typesense:explore.name: Pink Valley Terrace
typesense:explore.title: A housing complex full to the brim with dozens of pent-up old ladies and you're the only man!!
